text:
maya: Deploy finished on slice C at 11:15 PDT. Can folks run quick smoke and post results? I pushed a small DNS routing tweak; no config changes to models. Tagging @alex for rollout handoff.

alex: On it — starting smoke now. I'll check latency, error rate, and tokenization sanity.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T18:15Z completed for service inference-srv slice-C. CI checks passed.

sam: smoke: generation health ok for 5 samples, heavy-tail latency looks fine (p95 < 120ms), no 5xxs. embedding endpoint p99 spiked to 1.2s for 2/5 — investigating.

jordan: I see the embedding spike too on grafana panel 'embedding-latency'. SSHing into node gpu-03 now.

jordan: found a worker with a stale process that leaked mem; killed it and restarted the runtime. embedding p99 back to ~200ms. marking as resolved.

alex: Rollout plan: canary 10% -> hold 15m -> 50% if green. I've set the rollback flag in the ops console so we can revert quickly. Any objections?

tess: No objections. I'll watch routing/fallback. Noticing small increase in token cost due to batch sizing — if it persists we should drop batch-size to 8 in the quick config. Not urgent.

maya: Thanks. @jordan can you open a hotfix PR for the stale worker cleanup? If it's quick we can merge; otherwise we keep the rollback path ready.

jordan: PR opened: #4123 "kill-stale-worker-hotfix" — added liveness probe + max-retries. Quick changelog in PR. Restart command in the PR notes:
```sh
kubectl rollout restart deployment/inference-srv -n prod
```
Patch approved by @sam.

ops-bot: alert: canary at 10% stable for 6m. No errors >5% over baseline. Next rollout step scheduled at +15m.

maya: :thumbsup: Great work. I'll log this for the release notes and close the watch at +30m if nothing else pops up. Ping here for any regressions.
